title: Text fields
summary: A native single-line form control with Framework presentation, validation messaging and optional mask integration.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

size.description: The step of the control ladder the field stands on, the height of sf-button and sf-button-icon of the same size. sf-input keeps the outer steps 1/3 and 3 (a compact toolbar search, a hero search); the other fields stay on 1/2, 1 and 2.

radius.description: The field's corners, as sf-button's radius names them: empty and default are the controls' rounded square, square has none, rounded is a pill (a search field beside rounded buttons). --sf-input-radius still wins.

appearance.description: How the field looks: a bordered box, a filled one, or hidden.

label.description: The visible label above the field; it names the native control. Without it, give aria-label.

required.description: The field must hold a value: the label gets the required mark and the native control the required constraint.

placeholder.description: Example text shown in the empty field in the quiet ink; it disappears with the first character and is not a label.

input-type.description: The kind of text the field takes, the native input type: text, email, password (with a reveal button), search, tel, url or number (with min, max and step).

autocomplete.description: The autofill hint the browser reads, as the native autocomplete (email, tel, current-password, off). Empty: not written.

inputmode.description: Which on-screen keyboard a phone opens, as the native inputmode (numeric, decimal, tel, email, url, search). Empty: the keyboard of the type.

minlength.description: The fewest characters the value may have, as the native minlength; a shorter value is invalid (too short). Empty: no limit.

maxlength.description: The most characters the value may have, as the native maxlength: the field takes no more. Empty: no limit.

pattern.description: A regular expression the whole value must match, as the native pattern; a value that does not match is invalid (pattern mismatch).

min.description: The smallest number a number field (input-type number) takes, as the native input's min; below it the field is invalid (range underflow). Not written on other types.

max.description: The largest number a number field takes, as the native input's max; above it the field is invalid (range overflow). Not written on other types.

step.description: The step of a number field, as the native input's step: 1 when empty, any for any number; a value off the step is invalid (step mismatch). Not written on other types.

hint.description: The help line under the field; on an error the error message takes its place.

default-value.description: The value the field starts with and returns to on a form reset, without controlling it afterwards. Empty: value is used.

name.description: The name the value is sent under in a form, as the native name.

icon-start.description: The name of an icon drawn at the start of the field, before the value (a search glass, an envelope). Empty: no icon.

text-end.description: A short text drawn at the end of the field, after the value: a unit or a currency (kg, ₽, %). Empty: no text.

shortcut.description: A key combination drawn at the end of the field as the kbd component's soft caps in the muted ink (owner decisions C04, C38): words joined by +, e.g. mod+k (⌘K on a Mac, Ctrl K elsewhere), shift+mod+p, / or escape; mod is Cmd on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere. The keys take the text step one below the value's (size 1 a plate of 20 with letters of 14). Written as aria-keyshortcuts on the native input. A hint only: the field does not listen to it. Empty: no keys

hint-icon.description: The name of an icon drawn at the end of the field as a hint (info, help). Empty: no icon.

disabled.description: The field takes no input, no focus and is not sent with the form; it draws the disabled look.

readonly.description: The value can be read, selected and copied but not changed; it is sent with the form. The field draws the region line instead of the control border.

invalid.description: Marks the value as wrong: the error border, aria-invalid on the native control and error-message under the field.

error-message.description: The text shown under the field while it is invalid, in the error colour, in place of the hint; it is the control's error message for assistive technology.

mask.description: Turns on the input mask: typing is held to mask-pattern (or mask-options) and the fixed characters are drawn by the mask.

mask-pattern.description: The mask with mask on: 0 a digit, a a letter, * any character, {...} a fixed part kept in the value, [ ] an optional tail, \ escapes the next character; any other character is shown only. Example: +{7} (000) 000-00-00.

mask-lazy.description: With mask: true (or empty) shows the fixed characters only as they are reached, false shows the whole mask with placeholder characters from the start.

mask-placeholder-char.description: With mask and mask-lazy false: the character that stands for a position still to be typed. Empty: the mask's own, _.

mask-options.description: The full mask configuration as JSON, for what mask-pattern cannot say; it wins over mask-pattern. Invalid JSON is ignored.

value.description: The current value. Written by the page, it controls the field; the value property reads what is typed.

aria-label.description: Accessible name for a field rendered without a visible label; it lands on the native input.

type.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

inherited-value.description: What the field falls back to while it holds no value of its own -- a default from a parent setting, a brand, a theme. Shown as inherited, in the placeholder's ink with an «inherited» marker, never as the value: the form value stays empty. Once the field holds a value of its own, a reset button returns it here. A number field is sf-input with inputmode numeric or decimal and takes it the same way.

inherited-text.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

reset-label.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).

getInputElement.summary: Returns the inner native input, or null before render.

onInput.summary: Adds a listener for input on the host. Returns the element.

onChange.summary: Adds a listener for change on the host. Returns the element.

onKeyUp.summary: Adds a listener for keyup on the host. Returns the element.

onKeyDown.summary: Adds a listener for keydown on the host. Returns the element.

onFocus.summary: Adds a listener for focusin on the host. Returns the element.

onBlur.summary: Adds a listener for focusout on the host. Returns the element.

resetToInherited.summary: Returns the field to its inherited value, as the reset button does: fires the cancellable sf-field-reset, then empties the own value and focuses the control. Returns whether it was reset (false without an inherited value, without an own value, while disabled or readonly, or when the event was prevented).

change.summary: The value was committed; the native event bubbles from the inner input, which is its target. It carries no detail.

payload.description: A native Event: there is no detail.

input.summary: The value changed while typing; the native event bubbles from the inner input, which is its target. It carries no detail.

payload.description: A native Event: there is no detail.

sf-field-reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. The event of the trait field-inherit@1: one name for every field of the family, so a form hears them all at once and tells them apart by detail.tag. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

tag.description: The element that was reset, as a tag name.

value.description: The field's own value before the reset.

inheritedValue.description: The inherited value it returns to.

name.description: The form name, empty when the field has none.

sf-field:reset.summary: The person pressed the reset back to the inherited value. Fired before the field is emptied and cancellable: preventDefault keeps the value. When it is not prevented the field empties, says so with its ordinary change, shows the inherited value again and takes focus back.

value.description: The field's own value before the reset.

inheritedValue.description: The inherited value it returns to.

name.description: The form name, empty when the field has none.

accessibility.focus: Keep visible focus on the active control. After a reset back to the inherited value, focus returns to the control; while the value is inherited, the control carries it as aria-description and the visible marker is aria-hidden.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input for a single-line text, email, password, search, telephone or URL value that must participate in a native form.
do_not: Do not use Input for multiline text, numeric steppers, selects or date selection
Do not use the hidden presentation for visible interactive controls
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
